name: web-grocery-search-dropdown-mega-suggestions
title: Search Suggestion Dropdown over Product Grid
whatItIs: A grocery site with the search bar active: a wide white dropdown over a dimmed page lists suggestions and stores on the left and product results with images and prices on the right, above a grid of large product cards.
whatItMeans: Showing products as you type shortens the path to purchase, and the dimmed page focuses attention on the results.
techniques: Two-column dropdown separating text suggestions from rich product results
Bolding the matched part of each suggestion
Tinted rows for product results with thumbnail and price
View all results link as the exit
bestFor: Any site where discovery drives conversion

vocabulary.definition: Suggestions that appear while typing a query.
Search results that include images and prices, not just text.
Highlighting the typed part of a suggestion.
